# ACCEPTANCE

Observable **proof obligations** for the Active Stage. Preserve upstream success meaning; do not weaken it for implementation convenience.

- Core Generation: [MUST match CONTRACT and WORKPLAN]

Exact commands/scenarios are guidance rather than normative when Execution can use an equivalent or stronger source-honest method at the same subject, boundary, and proof strength.

## Acceptance Checks

### A1 — [Requirement / invariant / behavior]

Observe:
- [what result/subject must be observed]

Required boundary / strength:
- [unit / integration / real runtime / external/manual / delivered artifact / other]

Observation preconditions — when relevant:
- [fixture / control / instrumentation / environment / user/external condition needed for credible observation]

Suggested method — optional:
- [test / command / scenario / inspection]

If an exact command/tool/path/artifact is itself contractually significant, list it as part of the proof subject/expected result; it is not replaceable as mere mechanics.

Expected:
- [observable expected result]

Material dimensions — when relevant:
- target identity / revision / platform / configuration / locale / runtime / external boundary

If a known-feasible required observation depends on temporarily unavailable external/user environment, keep it explicit as `NOT RUN` with required input/environment and resume condition. If no credible observation path/precondition exists at all, Planning is not ready; do not substitute a weaker local check as PASS.

A PASS for one Material variant does not automatically prove an unobserved Materially different variant.

## Regression Checks — when relevant

- [Existing behavior materially affected → proof obligation]

## Delivery / First Run — when relevant

- [Verify actual final artifact and ordinary-user launch/entry path required by CONTRACT; development/test substitutes do not count]

## Operational Usability — when relevant

- [Only usability requirements actually adopted in CONTRACT]

Golden Path success does not satisfy unrelated uncovered Acceptance obligations.
